title: Network Courtesy Days for Network-Caused Delay (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Courtesy terms.** Under Rental Vehicle Coordination, days lost to a delay the network caused on an insurance claim repair are authorized on the rental as network delay courtesy days, paid by the network, where the class has network courtesy for its own delay; when the network's own sensor calibration on the repair order held the repair, the courtesy days are worked out from that calibration order.

Network courtesy days rest on no insurer request; they rest on the calibration order of the repair order the rental is for.

An authorization adds its days to the covered days on the rental ledger; it does not itself move the coverage end recorded on the reservation, which only the desk's coverage-end update sets.

## Business effect

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Rentals concerned | Insurance replacement rentals whose insurance claim repair the network's own delay held up |
| What they rest on | The calibration order of the insurance claim repair order the rental is for; no insurer request |
| Who pays | The network |
| Observable effect | One covered-day authorization with reason network delay courtesy, paid by the network and naming no extension request, stands on the reservation in the rental's day and money history, dated the day it is recorded; the rental's covered days grow by its days |

## Authorization tool: `authorize_network_courtesy_days_8334cede`

**Capability.** Authorizes network courtesy days on an insurance replacement rental: covered rental days paid by the network for a delay the network caused on the insurance claim repair the rental is for. One covered-day authorization (reason `network_delay_courtesy`, paid by the network, no insurer request) is added to the rental's day and money history, dated today; the rental's covered days grow by the days given.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `authorize_network_courtesy_days_8334cede` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_reservation_id` | Reference number of the rental reservation, as returned by the rental reservation lookup | Id |
| `claim_repair_id` | Reference number of the insurance claim repair order the rental is for, as shown on the reservation and returned by the claim repair lookup | Id |
| `authorization_number` | Ordinal of this authorization on the reservation: one more than the highest authorization number already on the rental | Integer, 1 or more |
| `days_count` | Courtesy days authorized | Integer count of rental days |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("authorized" when the authorization was recorded), `rental_entry_id` (reference number of the new authorization entry), `rental_reservation_id` (the reservation), `authorization_number` (integer ordinal), `authorization_reason` (always "network_delay_courtesy"), `paid_by` (always "network"), `days_count` (integer days authorized) and `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD).

## Contract illustration (hypothetical)

On a reservation whose highest authorization number is 1, the `authorization_number` passed is 2; a `days_count` of 3 returns a receipt reading `paid_by` "network" and `authorization_reason` "network_delay_courtesy".
